outcome: Change in hemoglobin level from admission to delivery
Total amount of iron administered before delivery
Time interval from admission to delivery
cohort: Hospitalized pregnant women with anemia (hemoglobin < 11 g/dL)
finding: Oral iron therapy in anemic inpatient pregnant women was not associated with higher hemoglobin concentrations before delivery.
mod_finding: While not statistically significant, cesarean delivery rates were high in both groups (control group: 53.7%; iron group: 72.4%; p=0.181).
